## What we do
SumerPlus is an integrated U.S. tax, accounting, and independent insurance practice.
We combine corporate and personal tax planning, bookkeeping/payroll, entity formation,
and Florida 2-15 (Life & Health) brokerage so clients are not forced to juggle
disconnected advisors.

## Core offerings
- Personal and business tax returns (including Forms 1120, 1120-S, 1065, Schedule C)
- Accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, estimated tax, sales tax, 1099 filing
- New business entity formation
- Independent insurance: group employee benefits, executive bonus / Section 162,
  buy-sell funding, key-person coverage, individual life and tax-aligned wealth strategies
- IRS representation and tax resolution support (integrated with protection planning)

## Free consultation
The initial strategy consultation and professional insurance advice from the
independent brokerage are free of charge with no obligation.
